collection.title: smoke: collections. The empty ones, the zero values, one element, indexes from 1, and the literals.

constant_assign.title: smoke: a constant can't be changed. Assigning it is a compile error and nothing runs.

constants.title: smoke: constants. set declares a value that never changes: typed or not, from an expression, global or local.

control.title: smoke: control flow. if, while, loop, for, match, break, skip, labels, the if suffix.

errors.title: smoke: errors. raise and recover, jobs with resume, the error codes, defer, exit, over, finalize.

logic.title: smoke: logic. The truth values and their operators; an error here is absurd and obvious.

numeric.title: smoke: numbers. Zero, one, the extremes of the types, the operators and the literals.

objects.title: smoke: objects. A class with a constructor, methods, visibility, inheritance, extension, comparison.

operators.title: smoke: operators. Precedence, associativity, compound forms, list operators, ranges, membership.

placeholders.title: smoke: placeholders. Names, literals, simple expressions, formats, code points, entities, escaped braces.

project.title: smoke: a project. One module, one aspect, one apply: import, life cycle order, safe and Atomic.

string.title: smoke: strings. The empty string, one character, concatenation, comparison, escapes and placeholders.

subprograms.title: smoke: subprograms. Functions, procedures, arguments, results, recursion, lambdas and closures.

topology.title: smoke: topology. The shape of a program: a driver, a process, functions, procedures, the order of the regions.

types.title: smoke: types. type(), is, conversions, optional values, ordinals, variants.

variables.title: smoke: variables. new, set and let; constants; sharing and copying; scopes.
